def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

add='''

def components(cells):
    """The 4-connected components of a set of (i, j) cells, each as a sorted list."""
    cells = set(cells); out = []
    while cells:
        start = next(iter(cells)); stack = [start]; comp = set()
        while stack:
            p = stack.pop()
            if p in comp: continue
            comp.add(p); cells.discard(p)
            i, j = p
            for q in [(i+1, j), (i-1, j), (i, j+1), (i, j-1)]:
                if q in cells: stack.append(q)
        out.append(sorted(comp))
    return out

def gravity_to_bar(grid, bar=2):
    """Every piece (connected nonzero cells) slides toward the solid one-color bar row and stacks against it and each other."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    br = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == bar)
    dirn = -1 if br == 0 else 1
    color = {(i, j): v for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0 and i != br}
    pieces = [(color[c[0]], c) for c in components(color.keys())]
    occ = [[False] * W for _ in range(H)]
    for j in range(W): occ[br][j] = True
    for v, pc in pieces:
        for i, j in pc: occ[i][j] = True
    moved = True
    while moved:
        moved = False
        for v, pc in pieces:
            own = set(pc)
            if all(0 <= i + dirn < H and (not occ[i + dirn][j] or (i + dirn, j) in own) for i, j in pc):
                for i, j in pc: occ[i][j] = False
                pc[:] = [(i + dirn, j) for i, j in pc]
                for i, j in pc: occ[i][j] = True
                moved = True
    out = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    out[br] = [bar] * W
    for v, pc in pieces:
        for i, j in pc: out[i][j] = v
    return out
'''
